aspect: Complaint and deportation become the same action
description: Raising unpaid wages, unsafe conditions or harassment risks the sponsorship, and losing the sponsorship means losing the right to remain. Every labour right becomes conditional on not using it.
energy_note: Every protection, void the moment you use it.

description: 'You've been here fourteen months. Fourteen months is nothing, visa-wise.' He says it pleasantly, while signing something else. 'Anyway. About Saturday - I'll need you in.' It is the fourth consecutive Saturday and there is no overtime.
energy_note: A fact about her visa, mentioned in passing, on a Thursday.

aspect: It is documented as a market, not a scandal
description: Where permits are scarce and bound to employers, brokerage appears and is measured by central banks rather than prosecuted - the structure is treated as an economic feature.
energy_note: A market in permission to work, with published figures.
notes: See WRK-002 in assets/text/nigeria and the permit rows in assets/text/palestine.

description: Changing sponsor means a new application, a gap in status, fees, and a reference from the person being left. Most people stay.
energy_note: The exit requires a reference from the problem.
